payload.reason: The evidence discusses the performance of models with different dialog turn sizes, indicating that dialog history is captured effectively with a turn size of 3 and 5.

claims.text: The proposed models capture dialog history effectively with a turn size of 3 and 5.
The IDCLM model outperforms others when using a dialog turn size of 5.
Contextual models may implicitly capture dialog context state changes.
Dialog history is treated as a sequence of inputs in previous models.
